body:
## 进展:formula 字段部分已修复(#3445 已合并)

已合并 PR #3445(squash 进 `main`,`1dc94f0`),解决了本 issue 的 **formula 公式字段** 部分。

**根因**:`formula` 是读取时(read-time)虚拟字段——引擎只在 `find`/`findOne` 取数后计算它,写入路径既不计算也不落库。而 record-change 触发器喂给流程的种子 `record` 直接来自生命周期钩子的原始行(`ctx.result` 叠加输入 doc),这一行根本不含公式字段,所以 `{record.full_name}` 被插值成空字符串。

**方案**:`RecordChangeTrigger`(`record` 的生产者)在组装种子记录后,对 `afterInsert`/`afterUpdate` 以系统身份**回读**刚写入的记录,让种子 `record` 与「数据 API 默认读取」拿到相同的计算字段。修复在触发器层,因此整条流程(开始条件、所有节点、notify 的 `title`/`body`)都受益,而非只给 notify 打补丁。刻意保守:原始字段优先合并、只补齐缺失的公式虚拟字段、任何失败都回退原始记录。

改动文件:`packages/triggers/trigger-record-change/src/record-change-trigger.ts`(核心为新增的 `hydrateComputedFields`);测试见 `record-change-trigger.test.ts` 与新增的 `formula-context.test.ts`。

---

## 仍待跟进(留给后续 agent)

本 issue **暂不关闭**,以下两点尚未处理:

### 1. lookup 跨表遍历 `{record.account.name}`
有意未在本次一并做:默认数据 API 读取本身也不展开关联;若在种子记录里默认展开,`record.account` 会从标量外键 id 变成对象,反而破坏那些把它当 id 用的模板/条件(例如 #1872 的 `{record.target_channels.0}`)。可选方向:
- **A(推荐先定方向)**:在 flow 节点上做 opt-in 的 `expand` 配置(显式声明展开哪些关联),回读时带上 `expand` 传给 `ObjectQL.findOne`(引擎已支持 `expand` map,见 `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 的 `expandRelatedRecords`)。
- **B**:在模板引擎里对 `record.<lookup>.<field>` 做惰性解析(需给 `template.ts` 的插值器注入数据引擎句柄)。

### 2. 构建期告警(issue 里的兜底诉求)
对模板引用了不可解析路径(尤其是 lookup 跨表)的情况,在 flow lint / publish gate 里加校验,把当前的**静默空白**变成**显式告警**。此项独立于 1,可先落地。

> 备注:formula 的旧 workaround(`{record.first_name} {record.last_name}` 重组)在 #3445 后已不再需要。

## Resolved — all three asks landed on `main`

Closing: every part of this report is now fixed.

| Ask | Fix | PR |
|---|---|---|
| `{record.full_name}` (formula field) renders blank | Trigger hydrates read-time formula virtuals via a system re-read of the just-written row | #3445 |
| No design-time signal for unresolvable template paths | New `os validate` rule `validateFlowTemplatePaths` — warns on unknown-field (`flow-template-unknown-field`) and lookup-traversal (`flow-template-lookup-traversal`) refs instead of a silent blank; plus re-read guards (skip when no formula field, memoize per write) | #3472 |
| `{record.account.name}` (lookup hop) renders blank | Opt-in single-hop expansion: a flow declares `expand: ['<lookup>']` on its start node and the engine re-reads the relation **as the run's own identity** (`runAs:'user'` ⇒ the triggering user, RLS/FLS enforced), grafting it onto the record so the template resolves | #3482 (closed #3475) |

Notes:
- Lookup expansion is **opt-in per relation** and read as the triggering user, so it never exposes fields that user couldn't read directly, and non-declared relations keep their scalar id (bare `{record.<lookup>}` and `multiple`-lookup arrays, #1872, are unchanged). Once a relation is declared in `config.expand`, the `flow-template-lookup-traversal` warning is suppressed.
- The formula workaround noted in the report (`{record.first_name} {record.last_name}`) is no longer needed since #3445.
- **Release**: all of the above are on `main`. The original report was on `@objectstack/*` 16.1.0 — these reach that install only in the next release cut.

Multi-hop traversal and a typed start-node schema for `expand` discoverability are possible future enhancements, out of scope here.
